Name: Desaturated Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: itstern
Description:
This mod uniformly desaturates all [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] assets for a softer look and better compatibility with popular recolors. Every asset, from portraits to items to maps and more, is desaturated. Other mods that edit SVE's assets will take priority over this one, so you can mix and match. Think of this mod as a catch-all for anything that isn't affected by another recolor mod.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pLgTcMBt/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

Should be compatible with all mods, including major expansions.

Version 1.0.3 is now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can turn desaturation on or off (default on) for individual characters' sprites or portraits, as well as for broad categories (like Furniture, Crops/forage, etc.).

This was specifically made to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/herbivoor?gameId=1303]Herbivoor[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url] (significant preset). I recommend using both!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLjYhfz5/troubleshooting.png[/img]

This mod does not edit SVE's Galdoran UI theme.

Desaturated SVE uses the same default config settings as SVE (for example, the kitchen retexture is turned on by default). Make sure your config options in this mod match those in your SVE configs.
